findings.summary: Undisclosed, untested behavior change: file_name's second caller Types::matched now sends names ending in '.' to the glob set, so -t/-T flip for files like 'Makefile.'; body only mentions hidden files and no types test exists (confirmed by check).
Two of the four new unit tests (file_name_basic, hidden_trailing_dot) duplicate coverage; drop them.
Pre-existing doc comment on file_name says root returns None but the Unix impl returns Some(""); out of scope for this PR.

why: The one blocking finding is a confirmed but side-effect behavior change in type matching that the reviewer says blocks merge pending a body note and a test; the maintainers merged without changes, so it is a likely false-positive block under the rubric.
